nodes.question: Has the background been changed to depict a basketball court?
nodes.criteria: complete: the background has been replaced with a basketball-court setting, supported by recognizable court cues such as a hoop, basketball, or court floor markings; the entire court need not be visible. partial: the background shows some basketball or court-related cues, but they do not establish a basketball-court setting, or the background change is only partial. absent: no visible progress toward changing the background to a basketball court. unknown: the image evidence is genuinely insufficient to determine whether the background depicts a basketball court.
nodes.binding: The image background; assess whether it depicts the requested basketball-court setting using visible court cues, without requiring the whole court to fit in frame.

program.checker_template: Execute exactly the supplied visual check on the source and edited images. Follow its saved binding, criteria and dependency evidence. Do not invent edits or infer an expected overall answer. Return JSON status, concise image-grounded evidence, and confidence (a number from 0 to 1, or null if unavailable). Confidence is your reported confidence in this check's observation, not a calibrated probability. A requested fulfillment check uses complete/partial/absent/unknown. A support check uses pass/fail/unknown. A known negative supporting observation can inform a requested check; it is not automatically uncertainty. Use unknown when the evidence cannot establish the requested fact. Do not count supporting facts as completed edits. Assess only the supplied check, not the overall instruction label.
